name: dark-mode
description: Enable dark mode theme across the entire UI. Requires the new design token system to be merged first.

name: new-onboarding-flow
description: Revamped onboarding wizard for first-time users. Depends on the profile service refactor and the email verification flag.

name: ai-suggestions
description: Surface AI-powered suggestions inside the code editor. No upstream blockers; can ship independently.

name: profile-service-v2
description: Refactored user profile service with new data model. Downstream dependency for new-onboarding-flow and settings redesign.

name: billing-v3
description: Third generation billing engine. Depends on the new payment provider integration being live.

name: payment-provider-stripe
description: Stripe as the primary payment provider, replacing the legacy gateway. No upstream blockers.

name: email-verification
description: Mandatory email verification step during sign-up. Blocks new-onboarding-flow from going live.

name: design-token-system
description: Foundational design token infrastructure. Required by dark-mode and the upcoming component library overhaul.

name: export-to-csv
description: Allow users to export their data as CSV. Standalone feature with no external blockers.

name: multi-region-failover
description: Automatic failover to secondary region on health-check failure. Depends on the monitoring dashboard flag and the new alerting pipeline.

name: monitoring-dashboard
description: Internal observability dashboard. Prerequisite for multi-region-failover and on-call alert routing.

name: alerting-pipeline-v2
description: Redesigned alerting pipeline with deduplication and escalation policies. No upstream blockers.
